newsitem.title: USA: Monterey Homes to acquire Legacy Homes.
newsitem.headline: Monterey Homes to acquire Legacy Homes.

text.p: Monterey Homes Corp said on Friday it agreed to acquire Legacy Homes, a privately held homebuilder in the Dallas-Fort Worth area.
Monterey said in a news release it will issue 666,667 shares of common stock as part of the deal.
Monterey also said the deal includes an option to acquire another 167,000 of its shares, and an additional consideration that was not specified in the release.
Legacy's founder, John Landon, will become chief operating officer and co-chief executive officer of Monterey, and will remain in Texas to oversee Legacy's daily operations.
Legacy had pre-tax income of $8.8 million on sales of $84 million in 1996, Monterey said.
Monterey builds single-family, luxury homes in Phoenix, Scottsdale and Tucson, Arizona.
